name: Athuga Affiliate Analytics
author: affiliateanalytics

sections.description:
Athuga Affiliate Analytics is a WordPress affiliate tracking and affiliate analytics plugin that helps you track affiliate links, affiliate clicks, unique clicks, cloaked links and performance. It helps publishers, affiliate marketers and website owners understand which affiliate links receive clicks, which pages generate affiliate activity, where visitors come from and how performance changes over time.

Athuga Affiliate Analytics is focused on affiliate activity rather than general website statistics. The Free plugin tracks affiliate clicks, unique clicks, anonymous visitors and sessions, pages, referrers, countries, devices, browsers and operating systems.

The plugin supports both direct affiliate URLs and common cloaked or redirected affiliate links. Configure your cloaked URL patterns and affiliate domains, and Athuga Affiliate Analytics can identify and track relevant affiliate activity without rewriting your links.

Core Features

  • Affiliate link tracking for direct affiliate URLs and cloaked links
  • Detailed affiliate click tracking
  • Unique clicks based on unique visitor and affiliate link combinations
  • Anonymous visitor and session analytics
  • Top affiliate assets and affiliate link performance
  • Page-level affiliate performance
  • Referrer and traffic-source analysis
  • Country analytics for affiliate traffic
  • Device, browser and operating-system analytics
  • Click trends and reporting-period comparisons
  • Today, yesterday and 7-day reporting
  • Affiliate performance reports
  • Automatic affiliate-link discovery and classification
  • Configurable cloaked URL patterns and affiliate domains
  • Local timezone reporting with daylight-saving support
  • Dark and light admin experiences

Affiliate Link Tracking

Athuga Affiliate Analytics can track affiliate links in two common ways:

  • Cloaked URL patterns — configure patterns such as /go/* for links handled by your site’s redirect or cloaking system.
  • Affiliate domains — add the domains used by your affiliate networks when direct affiliate URLs are used.

The plugin recognizes and records affiliate activity without requiring automatic affiliate-link rewriting.

Country Analytics

Athuga Affiliate Analytics includes local IPv4 country resolution using a compact bundled country database. Country resolution does not require an external geolocation API request.

The bundled country data is derived from DB-IP Lite.

Country data attribution:
https://db-ip.com/

DB-IP Lite is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0):
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Athuga Affiliate Analytics Pro

Athuga Affiliate Analytics Pro is a separate plugin that adds advanced analytics and reporting capabilities on top of the tracking foundation provided by Athuga Affiliate Analytics.

Pro features include advanced performance analysis, visitor activity, scheduled reports, real-time analytics, click-time analysis, audience and traffic analysis, affiliate link health checks, intelligence and opportunity analysis, extended reporting, CSV export and revenue analytics.

For information about the Pro plugin, visit:
https://affiliateanalytics.se/

Revenue Analytics (Pro)

Revenue Analytics in the separate Pro plugin connects affiliate traffic with conversion and payout data.

Features include:

  • Conversion tracking linked to affiliate clicks
  • Unique click IDs for conversion matching
  • Conversion and revenue reporting
  • EPC (earnings per click) when conversion and payout data can be matched
  • Click-versus-revenue comparisons
  • Conversion postback support
  • Unmatched conversion storage
  • CSV conversion import
  • Revenue data for Pro intelligence and opportunity analysis

How It Works

Athuga Affiliate Analytics identifies affiliate activity from configured cloaked URL patterns and affiliate domains. It records analytics events and uses anonymous visitor and session identifiers for reporting.

The reporting layer organizes affiliate activity by asset, page, referrer, country, device, browser, operating system and time.

The plugin stores event timestamps in UTC and presents reporting periods using the viewer’s local browser timezone.

Configuration

Configure the affiliate links you want to track under Athuga Affiliate Analytics → Setup.

  • Cloaked URL patterns — define patterns such as /go/*.
  • Affiliate domains — add the domains used by your affiliate networks for direct affiliate URLs.

The plugin does not require automatic affiliate-link rewriting.

Reporting Periods and Timezones

Core reporting includes today, yesterday and 7-day periods. Reporting uses the viewer’s local browser timezone, including daylight-saving changes.

Athuga Affiliate Analytics stores event timestamps in UTC and converts them for reporting.

Privacy

Depending on site activity, analytics records can include page URLs, referrer information, country, device, browser, operating system, language and hashed technical identifiers. The plugin uses anonymous visitor and session identifiers and does not store the raw visitor identifier used to create the visitor hash.

Athuga Affiliate Analytics uses cookies for anonymous visitor and session identification and a browser timezone cookie for local reporting.

Country resolution in the Free plugin uses the bundled local IPv4 country database and does not send visitor IP addresses to an external geolocation service.

Installing the plugin by itself does not make a website compliant with GDPR, ePrivacy or other privacy laws. Site owners are responsible for determining the legal basis, consent requirements, privacy notices and configuration appropriate for their website and visitors.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the athuga-affiliate-analytics folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin ZIP through WordPress.
  2. Activate Athuga Affiliate Analytics from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Open Athuga Affiliate Analytics → Setup.
  4. Configure cloaked URL patterns and affiliate domains if needed.
  5. Open Athuga Affiliate Analytics → Dashboard.

No external analytics account is required for core reporting.
sections.faq:
How do I track affiliate clicks in WordPress?

Configure your cloaked URL patterns or affiliate domains in Athuga Affiliate Analytics → Setup. The plugin then records relevant affiliate clicks and makes them available in the dashboard.

How do I track affiliate links in WordPress?

Athuga Affiliate Analytics can track direct affiliate URLs and cloaked or redirected affiliate links without requiring automatic link rewriting.

What is a unique affiliate click?

A unique click represents a unique visitor and affiliate link combination within the selected reporting period. Repeated clicks from the same visitor on the same affiliate link count once as a unique click while total clicks continue to include the recorded events.

Does it support cloaked links and link cloaking?

Yes. Define cloaked URL patterns such as /go/*, or add the domains used by your affiliate networks for direct affiliate URLs.

Can I see which pages generate affiliate clicks?

Yes. Athuga Affiliate Analytics provides page-level affiliate performance so you can see which pages generate affiliate activity and which affiliate assets receive clicks.

Can I analyze affiliate traffic by country or device?

Yes. Country, device, browser and operating-system dimensions are available in the Free plugin. The separate Pro plugin adds deeper audience and traffic analysis.

Does the plugin use an external geolocation service?

No. The Free plugin uses a bundled local IPv4 country database for country resolution.

What does Athuga Affiliate Analytics Pro add?

The separate Pro plugin adds deeper performance analysis, visitor activity, audience and traffic analysis, real-time analytics, click-time analysis, advanced reports, intelligence, opportunities, affiliate link health, scheduled reports, extended reporting and revenue analytics.

Does Pro track affiliate revenue?

Yes. Pro Revenue Analytics can match conversions using unique click IDs, conversion postbacks and optional CSV imports.

What is EPC in affiliate marketing?

EPC means earnings per click. Pro can report EPC when conversion and payout data can be matched to affiliate clicks.

Can affiliate clicks be matched to conversions?

Yes. Pro can match conversions using unique click IDs. Conversions that cannot be matched are retained so their revenue can still be reported.

Does Athuga Affiliate Analytics rewrite my affiliate links?

No. The plugin recognizes and tracks affiliate activity based on your configured URL patterns and domains. It does not require automatic affiliate-link rewriting.

Does Athuga Affiliate Analytics include a cookie consent system?

No. Athuga Affiliate Analytics does not replace a site’s cookie-consent or consent-management platform. Site owners should use the privacy and consent tools appropriate for their website.
sections.changelog:
1.0.5

  • Added nonce verification to public tracking and discovery AJAX requests.
  • Hardened public AJAX request handling against unauthorized state changes.

1.0.4

  • Added local IPv4 country resolution using a bundled compact country database.
  • Country resolution no longer depends on external geolocation requests.
  • Continued compatibility with existing Country analytics and session data.
  • Improved WordPress.org compatibility by keeping Pro-only functionality out of the Free plugin.
